sermon.title: Destined to Die 11/18/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In the tenth session of Bible truths only cons disagree with, Pastor David G. Kincer shows that every human is destined to die and then face judgment. He contrasts other beliefs with Scripture, walks through the rich man and Lazarus, lists the leading and preventable causes of death, and points to the blood of Jesus that cleanses from all sin.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Health and mortality statistics are read from news and health sources and were not checked.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast. For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And let us consider one another in order to stir up love and good works, not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

faqs.question: How many does he say Stalin killed?
What does he say Jews believe about death?
faqs.answer: Nothing happens until God resurrects soul and body.

faqs.question: Can baptism for the dead help someone in hell?
Were Obama and Trump Christians?
faqs.answer: He says they said they were, and it’s not his job to judge.

faqs.question: Can a same-sex person or adulterer be a minister?
What will come before Christ returns?
faqs.answer: Stars falling, turmoil in the oceans and plagues.
